resources.name: shared-log-analytics-ingestion-appinsights
resources.notes: Azure Resource Manager MCP get_retail_prices; productName=Log Analytics; skuName=Analytics Logs; meterName=Analytics Logs Data Ingestion; meterId=e3669cc9-19b6-55fc-b9fe-782ab83615ab; unitOfMeasure=1 GB; priceType=Consumption (on-demand PAYG); currency=USD; returned billing region=swedencentral. Owner-approved usage is 2 GB/month aggregate for workspace-based Application Insights ingestion into central workspace log-management, not per instance. Returned tier rows include $0 at tierMinimumUnits=0 and $2.99/GB at tierMinimumUnits=5. Per owner assumption, apply no free monthly allowance because the central workspace allowance is shared across the landing zone; price all 2 GB at $2.99/GB: 2 GB x $2.99 = $5.98/month. Retention is within the included period; no extra retention meter included. No commitment discount.

resources.name: shared-hub-firewall-data-processing
resources.notes: Azure Resource Manager MCP get_retail_prices; productName=Azure Firewall; skuName=Standard; meterName=Standard Data Processed; meterId=5f492263-6ee9-488d-9b66-02332b889b03; unitOfMeasure=1 GB; priceType=Consumption (on-demand PAYG); currency=USD; returned billing region=swedencentral. Catalog armSkuName is empty; the returned productName, skuName and exact meter identify the verified Standard data-processing meter. Owner-approved usage is 5 GB/month aggregate, not per instance, at $0.016/GB: 5 GB x $0.016 = $0.08/month. Scope includes web app outbound traffic including MCR image pulls and App Insights ingestion, image pushes from the dev VM to ACR, and MI link seeding (~200 MB); app-to-private-endpoint traffic inside the VNet is excluded. Fixed firewall deployment hours are excluded because they are owned by the landing zone. No commitment discount.
